description: This file implements the core functions of a DSL home model object controller, including creation, initialization, enrollment, and removal of the object. It defines functions for managing object lifecycle and basic behaviors in a component-based network device.

classes.name: DSLH_OBJ_CONTROLLER_OBJECT
classes.description: Structure representing the object controller for DSLH, comprising member variables and function pointers for object management.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE DslhObjcoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new instance of the DSLH object controller, setting up its base object and function pointers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS DslhObjcoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the object instance, performing cleanup and resource deallocation.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS DslhObjcoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls or registers subordinate objects required by this controller.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS DslhObjcoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the object instance, setting default values for member variables and method pointers.
